findings.evidence: Lines 736–742 declare the `...exists_dualFeasible...` name, while the existential conjunct at line 740 is `(∀ i j, φ i + ψ j ≤ c (i, j))`, not `DualFeasible ...`.
findings.fix: Rename the theorem to describe the actual expanded condition, such as `forall_cost_le_iff_exists_forall_add_le_and_support_subset_contactSet`, or change the statement to use an appropriate named feasibility predicate.
findings.issue: `forall_cost_le_iff_exists_dualFeasible_and_support_subset_contactSet` says the conclusion contains `DualFeasible`, but it contains only the expanded real inequality `∀ i j, φ i + ψ j ≤ c (i, j)`. This makes the API misleading and violates the convention that underscore-separated components correspond to definitions or connectives.

summary: One theorem name advertises a named predicate that does not occur in its statement.
